notes.title: What's New in Version 1.2
notes.content:
What's New in Version 1.2:

Rework the visual effects.
Overall gameplay reworks and tweaks.
Improved animation effects.
Added dual views of character and ship.
The operation mode is changed from the original restricted rear to free movement.
New item.
New levels have been added.
New enemies and bosses.
boss animation increased.
Bullet level cap increased to 5.
- M and L shells are temporarily removed (M and L shells will be added in later versions after they are improved).
